subject: Dashboard sign-in tokens and mobile access
statements: by know deactivate this token mechanism, we active later in the deployment
create also a url where I can access by mobile
decision: Viewer/auditor sign-in is switched off until deployment (config/factory/dashboard-access.yaml auth: disabled, anonymous role viewer) for requests from this machine. For phone access the dashboard may also listen on the Tailscale and Wi-Fi addresses; requests from any address other than this machine still need the viewer/auditor token (one-time login link, then a cookie).
agent_note: The token stays required for other devices because a dashboard without sign-in on a network address would expose factory data to every device on that network; the owner can still choose otherwise.
not_changed: AFO operator token for pause/drain/resume; loopback-only default listen address; at deployment set auth: token
